item.title: Solid Sound Festival Announces 2026 Lineup
item.description: Wilco will bring their Solid Sound festival back to MASS MoCA in North Adams, MA this summer. Taking place June 26-28, the event will feature sets from both Wilco and Jeff Tweedy and a previously announced collaboration with Billy Bragg performing their collaborative Mermaid Avenue material. Other Wilco members' bands the Autumn Defense and Nels Cline’s Consentrik Quartet will play, and Mikael Jorgensen will screen his new film abou Bob James with a Q&A. item.title: Tobias Jesso Jr. Gives First Public Performance In A Decade On Kimmel
item.description: In 2015, Tobias Jesso Jr. released his debut album Goon with a great deal of critical and promotional clamor. He then quickly disappeared from the spotlight in favor of a fruitful behind-the-scenes career that led him to win the first ever Grammy for Songwriter Of The Year, among other highlights.
